# Calendar assets

Locally served MIT-licensed bundles, downloaded from the official npm packages:

- `fullcalendar` 6.1.22: `index.global.min.js`, `LICENSE.md`
- `@fullcalendar/core` 6.1.22: `locales/es.global.min.js`
- `@fullcalendar/luxon3` 6.1.22: `luxon3.global.min.js`, `LUXON3-LICENSE.md`
- `luxon` 3.7.2: `luxon.min.js`, `LUXON-LICENSE.md`

The Luxon connector implements named IANA time zones and daylight-saving rules.
No CDN requests or build step are required in production.

Documentation: https://legacy.fullcalendar.io/v6/initialize-globals and https://legacy.fullcalendar.io/v6/luxon
